meta.themes: Policy & Safety, Enterprise Agents, Infra Partnerships, Market Dislocation

news.title: OpenAI published an industrial-policy framework for the superintelligence transition
news.summary: OpenAI released a people-first policy agenda spanning shared prosperity, grid and workforce adaptation, and coordinated AI safety incident response, plus grants and a D.C. workshop track to advance the debate.

news.title: Anthropic signed Google and Broadcom for multi-gigawatt next-generation TPU capacity
news.summary: Anthropic said the expanded agreement secures large-scale Google Cloud TPU runway starting in 2027, mostly in the U.S., while reaffirming AWS as its primary training partner and multi-cloud availability through Azure Foundry.

news.title: Google updated Gemini with faster crisis pathways and $30M for global hotlines
news.summary: Google rolled out a redesigned mental-health help module and one-touch crisis routing in Gemini, committed $30M over three years to hotline capacity, and tightened minor-facing safeguards alongside clinical partners.

news.title: Anthropic launched Project Glasswing to harden critical software with Claude Mythos Preview
news.summary: Anthropic convened major cloud, device, and security partners to apply a limited-access frontier model to defensive vulnerability work, backed by up to $100M in credits and pledged public learning reports within 90 days.

news.title: Anthropic detailed how Claude Mythos Preview shifts the bar for automated security review
news.summary: Anthropic’s security research team published evaluation methodology and early findings for Mythos Preview, arguing the capability jump demands coordinated defender access, tighter safeguards, and industry-wide playbook updates.

news.title: Reuters examined how Anthropic’s revenue surge reframes the OpenAI IPO narrative
news.summary: Reuters reported Anthropic’s disclosed run-rate revenue has climbed past OpenAI’s annualized figure, intensifying the race for enterprise share as both companies prepare for potential late-2026 listings alongside other mega-IPOs.

news.title: OpenAI introduced a Child Safety Blueprint for AI-era exploitation prevention
news.summary: OpenAI published a stakeholder-backed framework covering state law modernization, higher-signal reporting to NCMEC, and safety-by-design controls to detect and interrupt AI-enabled child sexual exploitation earlier in the harm chain.

news.title: U.S. software shares slid as Anthropic’s Mythos disclosure revived AI disruption fears
news.summary: Reuters said the S&P 500 software and services index fell sharply as investors priced faster automation risk, with cybersecurity and enterprise SaaS names leading declines after Anthropic limited broad release of its new model.

news.title: Intel and Google announced a deeper multiyear push on Xeon, IPUs, and AI cloud efficiency
news.summary: Intel’s newsroom said the companies will align Xeon generations across Google Cloud fleet shapes while expanding custom ASIC-based IPU co-development to offload networking, storage, and security from host CPUs for heterogeneous AI stacks.

news.title: ChatGPT added a $100/month Pro tier and rebalanced Codex limits across Plus and Pro
news.summary: OpenAI’s ChatGPT release notes introduced a lower-cost Pro tier with higher Codex allowances, kept a $200 heavy-usage tier, and adjusted Plus limits to spread coding-agent usage more evenly through the week.

news.title: Microsoft began stripping prominent Copilot buttons from core Windows 11 inbox apps
news.summary: The Verge reported Insider-channel updates replacing Copilot entry points in Notepad, Snipping Tool, Photos, and Widgets with subtler writing-tool menus while retaining underlying AI features, matching Microsoft’s promise to reduce UI clutter.

news.title: OpenAI disclosed an Axios supply-chain exposure in a macOS signing workflow
news.summary: Reuters summarized OpenAI’s statement that a compromised third-party Axios package reached a GitHub Actions signing pipeline, prompting certificate refreshes and mandatory macOS app updates while the company reported no user-data access.
